messages:
maya: Quick regional bench summary for L4 / T4 / A10G across embeddings + small-chat. TL;DR: A10G best for low-latency small-chat, L4 most cost-effective for high-throughput embeddings when batched. Full notes below.

benchbot: completed run rb-5623
Command: ./bench_harness --models l4,t4,a10g --workloads embeddings,small-chat --regions us-central1,eu-west1,asia-east1 --quant q4_0,int8,fp16 --batches 1,16,64 --seq 128,256 --samples 80k
(warmup 8m each config, autotune enabled)

zack: Kernel findings:
- A10G: flash-attn + CUTLASS path gives consistent p95 wins for decoding on 256 tokens.
- T4: hits several fallback paths at seq>200, p95 has higher variance.
- L4: excels at large-batch embedding throughput and KV-cache reuse; lower per-token GPU time.

lucy: Aggregated median metrics (per repeated runs, cost normalized per 1M tokens):
A10G | us-central1 | small-chat (256) | p50=38ms | p95=110ms | gen=28 req/s | cost=$14
A10G | eu-west1   | small-chat (256) | p50=45ms | p95=140ms | gen=23 req/s | cost=$17
A10G | asia-east1  | small-chat (256) | p50=52ms | p95=170ms | gen=19 req/s | cost=$19

L4  | us-central1 | embeddings (32 tokens, bs=64) | p50=8ms  | p95=25ms  | embed=14k req/s | cost=$5
T4  | us-central1 | embeddings (32 tokens, bs=64) | p50=12ms | p95=48ms  | embed=8k  req/s | cost=$3.5

maya: Key interpret: L4 offers best $/token at scale thanks to throughput; T4 has slightly cheaper instance price but saturates earlier. A10G is the latency winner for small-chat and worth the premium for p95-sensitive routes.

tariq: Capacity sketch (target: 12k embeddings qps, bs=64):
- L4: observed ~2k qps per GPU steady -> ~6 GPUs +20% headroom => recommend 7-8 L4s.
- T4: ~1.2k qps per GPU -> ~10 GPUs + headroom => recommend 12 T4s.
- A10G: not recommended for pure embeddings fleet (costly).

lucy: Quantization notes:
- q4_0: embeddings quality statistically indistinguishable vs fp16 for our eval set; perf +25-35% on L4/T4.
- int8: small-chat gets ~30-40% perf/cost win on A10G, but ~1-1.5% of eval prompts show decoding artifacts (formatting/safety edge cases). Flagged prompts and will expand eval set.

zack: Ops gotcha: asia-east1 A10G AMI needed CUTLASS v3.2+ or we lose ~7% throughput. Pinned image in CI.

lucy: Mini ascii summary for quick share:
workload    best    est $/1M    p50   p95
embeddings  L4      $5          8ms   25ms
small-chat  A10G    $14         38ms  110ms

maya: Next steps/action items:
- Run 24h stability sweep on top configs per region (rb-5624).
- Build Eval Set B (20k prompts) focused on formatting/safety to stress int8.
- Prototype hybrid routing: embeddings->L4, low-latency chat->A10G, fallback->T4.
